svg.title: Model identification and behavioral profiling routes
svg.desc: Agent traces jointly reflect tool, model, task, and skill effects. Route A assigns only within known identity references. Route B reuses a shared behavioral fingerprint across compatible logs and offers relative similarity cues for analyst-led association review.

g.text: Models, versions, tools, and skills vary
Model / harness identity may be unknown
Use common B/S/T measures on compatible logs

svg.metadata: Editable vector artwork. Brand marks are bundled in figures/tool-icons; DSH denotes DeepSeek Harness.
